fix.note: Opposite: 開 (hoi1). In speech, 閂 (saan1) for doors and 熄 (sik1) for lights are common.

ex.r: ceot1 mun4 hau2 gei3 dak1 gwaan1 dang1
ex.en: Remember to turn off the lights when you go out.

ex.r: gaan1 pou3 tau2 gei2 dim2 gwaan1 mun4 aa3
ex.en: What time does the shop close?

ex.en: It's so cold, can we turn off the air conditioning?

ex.r: ngo5 do1 sou3 co5 dei6 tit3 faan1 gung1

fix.note: Measure word 塊 (faai3): 塊面. 洗面 = wash your face.

ex.s: 佢塊面好紅，係咪發燒呀？
ex.r: keoi5 faai3 min6 hou2 hung4 hai6 mai6 faat3 siu1 aa3
ex.en: Her face is really red. Does she have a fever?

ex.r: sai2 jyun4 min6 sin1 sik6 zou2 caan1
ex.en: Wash your face before you have breakfast.

ex.r: nei5 faai3 min6 jau5 di1 je5
